+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+out = Path("./out")
+out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+data = duckdb.connect().execute(
+    """
+    SELECT
+        year(crash_date) AS year,
+        sum(coalesce(number_of_motorist_killed, 0)) AS motorist_deaths,
+        sum(coalesce(number_of_cyclist_killed, 0)) AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('./data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY 1
+    ORDER BY 1
+    """
+).df()
+
+data = pd.DataFrame({"year": range(2013, 2026)}).merge(
+    data, on="year", how="left"
+).fillna(0)
+data[["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]] = data[
+    ["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]
+].astype(int)
+data.to_csv(out / "values.csv", index=False)
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10})
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5, 6.5))
+fig.patch.set_facecolor("#ffffff")
+ax.set_facecolor("#fbfcfe")
+ax.plot(
+    data.year, data.motorist_deaths, color="#244c7c", marker="o",
+    linewidth=2.8, markersize=6, label="Motorists"
+)
+ax.plot(
+    data.year, data.cyclist_deaths, color="#d66a3a", marker="o",
+    linewidth=2.8, markersize=6, label="Cyclists"
+)
+
+for x, y in zip(data.year, data.motorist_deaths):
+    ax.annotate(
+        str(y), (x, y), xytext=(0, 9), textcoords="offset points",
+        ha="center", color="#244c7c", fontsize=8
+    )
+for x, y in zip(data.year, data.cyclist_deaths):
+    ax.annotate(
+        str(y), (x, y), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points",
+        ha="center", color="#a94a23", fontsize=8
+    )
+
+ax.set_title(
+    "Motorist deaths far outnumber cyclist deaths", loc="left",
+    fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", color="#182b42", pad=20
+)
+ax.text(
+    0, 1.02, "Annual people killed in NYC motor-vehicle crashes | 2013–2025",
+    transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10, color="#5a6a7b"
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Year", labelpad=10, color="#405367")
+ax.set_ylabel("Deaths", labelpad=9, color="#405367")
+ax.set_xticks(data.year)
+ax.set_ylim(0, 155)
+ax.set_yticks(range(0, 151, 25))
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dce3eb", linewidth=0.8)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#b8c4d0")
+ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=0, pad=7, labelcolor="#526273")
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 0.96))
+ax.text(
+    0, -0.18,
+    "Counts sum the killed-person fields for each road-user type; values shown at every point.",
+    transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, color="#6b7886"
+)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(out / "initial.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+
+print(data.to_string(index=False))
+print(f"Saved {out / 'initial.png'} and {out / 'values.csv'}")
*** End Patch
